_doc: One entry per finished reel. build: script under the repo (template reels use template/build_reel.sh <id>). hook: first sung line that opens the reel (audio:from:to:line, 'auto' = from sloka.json word_timings). out: file name in Drive Chinni Slokalu/Reels. post: name, name_te, when, tags for ./reel meta (the text the publisher posts).

post.name: Vakratunda Mahakaya
post.hook: 🐘✨ Vakratunda Mahakaya – Ganesha Sloka for Kids 🌺
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to pray to Lord Ganesha before every new start. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with confidence and clear every obstacle from their path. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it before any new task, exam or journey. ఏ పని మొదలుపెట్టినా ముందుగా గణపతికి చెప్పుకునే శ్లోకం.

post.name: Saraswati Namastubhyam
post.hook: 🙏📚 Saraswati Namastubhyam – The Study Sloka for Kids 🌸
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to pray to Maa Saraswati before they start to read or learn. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with wisdom, focus and a love for learning. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it before study, school or any new lesson. చదువు మొదలుపెట్టే ముందు సరస్వతీ దేవికి నమస్కారంగా చెప్పుకోండి.

post.name: Hanuman Bedtime Sloka
post.hook: 🌙🐒 Ramam Skandam Hanumantam – Bedtime Sloka for Kids ⭐
post.blurb: Teach your little ones this bedtime sloka that keeps bad dreams away. Let it fill their hearts with courage and give them a calm, happy sleep. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it at bedtime, for peaceful sleep. రాత్రి పడుకునే ముందు చెప్పుకుంటే చెడు కలలు రావు.

post.name: Gayatri Mantra
post.hook: ☀️✨ Om Bhur Bhuvah Swaha – Gayatri Mantra for Kids 🌸
post.blurb: Teach your little ones the Gayatri Mantra, a prayer for a bright and good mind. Let this divine mantra fill their hearts with light, focus and wisdom. ❤️🪔
post.when: Chant it at sunrise or before study. సూర్యోదయ సమయంలో లేదా చదువుకు ముందు జపించండి.

post.name: Guru Brahma
post.when: Say it before study or class, to thank every teacher. చదువు మొదలుపెట్టే ముందు గురువులకు నమస్కారంగా చెప్పుకోండి.
post.hook: 🙏✨ Guru Brahma Guru Vishnu – A Beautiful Sloka for Kids 🌸
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to respect and seek blessings from their Gurus. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with wisdom, knowledge and positivity. ❤️🪔

post.name: Deepa Jyothi Sloka
post.hook: 🪔✨ Deepa Jyothi Parabrahma – Lamp Sloka for Kids 🌼
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to bow to the lamp's light every evening. Let this divine sloka fill their homes and hearts with brightness and goodness. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it when the evening lamp is lit. సాయంత్రం దీపం వెలిగించినప్పుడు చెప్పుకునే శ్లోకం.

post.name: Asato Ma Sadgamaya
post.hook: 🪔✨ Asato Ma Sadgamaya – Prayer for Light for Kids 🌅
post.blurb: Teach your little ones this ancient prayer to move from untruth to truth and from darkness to light. Let it fill their hearts with honesty, courage and peace. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it in the morning prayer or before lighting the lamp. ఉదయం ప్రార్థనలో లేదా దీపం వెలిగించే ముందు చెప్పుకోండి.

post.name: Karpura Gauram
post.when: Said at the end of aarti, to Lord Shiva and Mother Parvati. హారతి సమయంలో శివపార్వతులకు చెప్పుకునే శ్లోకం.
post.hook: 🔱✨ Karpura Gauram – Shiva's Aarti Sloka for Kids 🌙
post.blurb: Teach your little ones the sloka sung at the end of every aarti, to Lord Shiva and Mother Parvati. Let it fill their hearts with love, calm and devotion. ❤️🪔

post.name: Sarva Mangala Mangalye
post.hook: 🌺✨ Sarva Mangala Mangalye – Devi Sloka for Kids 🔱
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to pray to Mother Durga, the goodness in every good thing. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with strength, kindness and joy. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it in the evening prayer and during Navaratri. సాయంత్రం పూజలో, నవరాత్రుల్లో చెప్పుకోండి.

post.name: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
post.hook: 🕉️✨ Om Tryambakam – Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra for Kids 🔱
post.blurb: Teach your little ones Lord Shiva's mantra for health, strength and courage. Let this divine mantra fill their hearts with peace and free them from every fear. ❤️🪔
post.when: Chant it in the morning or at bedtime, for health and courage. ఉదయం లేదా పడుకునే ముందు ఆరోగ్యం, ధైర్యం కోసం చెప్పుకోండి.

post.name: Om Saha Navavatu
post.hook: 📖✨ Om Saha Navavatu – Study Together Prayer for Kids 🌼
post.blurb: Teach your little ones the prayer that teachers and students say together before a lesson. Let it fill their hearts with friendship, focus and a love for learning. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it at the start of class or study time, together. పాఠం మొదలయ్యే ముందు గురువు, శిష్యులు కలిసి చెప్పుకునే మంత్రం.

post.name: Surya Namaskara Sloka
post.hook: ☀️✨ Japakusuma Sankasham – Sun Sloka for Kids 🌺
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to greet the Sun God every morning. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with energy, health and brightness. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it at sunrise, facing the Sun. ఉదయం సూర్యుడికి ఎదురుగా నిలబడి చెప్పుకోండి.

post.name: Mahalakshmi Sloka
post.hook: 🪷✨ Namastestu Mahamaye – Lakshmi Sloka for Kids 💰
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to pray to Maa Lakshmi for a happy, blessed home. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with gratitude, kindness and joy. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it on Fridays and at the evening lamp. శుక్రవారం, సాయంత్రం దీపం వేళ చెప్పుకోండి.

post.name: Shantakaram Bhujagashayanam
post.hook: 🐚✨ Shantakaram Bhujagashayanam – Vishnu Sloka for Kids 🪷
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to bow to Lord Vishnu, who is always calm and removes every fear. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with peace and courage. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it in the morning prayer or before sleep. ఉదయం ప్రార్థనలో లేదా పడుకునే ముందు చెప్పుకోండి.

post.name: Krishna Sloka
post.hook: 🦚✨ Vasudeva Sutam Devam – Krishna Sloka for Kids 🪈
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to bow to Lord Krishna, the teacher of the whole world. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with joy, love and goodness. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it in the morning prayer, or on Janmashtami. ఉదయం ప్రార్థనలో, కృష్ణాష్టమి రోజున చెప్పుకోండి.

post.name: Sri Rama Rama Rameti
post.hook: 🏹✨ Sri Rama Rama Rameti – Rama Sloka for Kids 🌸
post.blurb: Teach your little ones that one loving chant of Rama's name is as good as a thousand. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with peace, truth and devotion. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it any time of day, and on Sri Rama Navami. ఎప్పుడైనా, శ్రీరామనవమి రోజున ప్రత్యేకంగా చెప్పుకోండి.

post.name: Bhojana Mantram
post.hook: 🍛🙏 Brahmarpanam – Food Prayer for Kids 🌾
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to thank God before every meal. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with gratitude for the food on their plate. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it before every meal. భోజనం చేసే ముందు చెప్పుకునే మంత్రం.

post.name: Venkateswara Suprabhatam
post.hook: 🌅✨ Kausalya Supraja Rama – Suprabhatam for Kids 🙏
post.blurb: Teach your little ones the morning song that wakes Lord Venkateswara. Let it fill their mornings with music, devotion and a happy start to the day. ❤️🪔
post.when: Sing it at dawn, to start the day. తెల్లవారుజామున రోజు మొదలుపెట్టేటప్పుడు పాడుకోండి.

post.name: Karagre Vasate Lakshmi
post.hook: 🌅🙏 Karagre Vasate Lakshmi – Morning Sloka for Kids 🌸
post.blurb: Teach your little ones to start each day by looking at their own hands, where Lakshmi, Saraswati and Govinda live. Let this divine sloka fill their hearts with gratitude and joy for every new morning. ❤️🪔
post.when: Say it first thing in the morning, looking at your open palms. పొద్దున్నే నిద్ర లేవగానే అరచేతులు చూసుకుంటూ చెప్పుకునే శ్లోకం.

post.name: Hanuman Chalisa
post.hook: 🚩🙏 Shri Hanuman Chalisa – Full Chant for Kids 🐒
post.blurb: Teach your little ones the Hanuman Chalisa, verse by verse. Let it fill their hearts with courage, strength and devotion to Lord Hanuman. ❤️🪔
post.when: Chant it on Tuesdays and Saturdays, or any time you need courage. మంగళవారం, శనివారం లేదా ధైర్యం కావాలనుకున్నప్పుడు చదువుకోండి.
